title: Best Private Search Engines: DuckDuckGo vs Startpage Compared
metaDescription: Compare the top private search engines like DuckDuckGo, Startpage, and Brave Search. Find the best anonymous search tool for your privacy needs.
intro: Traditional search engines track your every query, building detailed profiles for advertisers. Private search engines offer a better way - delivering quality results without surveillance. We've compared the leading privacy-focused search engines to help you choose.

verdict.summary: DuckDuckGo leads for most users with its perfect balance of privacy, speed, and usability. Startpage excels when you need Google's comprehensive results without tracking. Brave Search shows promise as an independent alternative, while Searx appeals to technical users who want complete control.

faqs.question: Are private search engines as good as Google?
faqs.answer: Private search engines have made significant improvements in result quality. While Google's results may be more comprehensive due to their massive data collection, private alternatives like DuckDuckGo and Startpage provide excellent results for most searches without compromising your privacy.

faqs.question: Do private search engines really not track you?
faqs.answer: Reputable private search engines like DuckDuckGo and Startpage have strict no-logging policies and don't track users. However, your ISP and government can still see your searches unless you use additional privacy tools like a VPN or the Incognito Browser for enhanced protection.

faqs.question: Can I set a private search engine as my default?
faqs.answer: Yes, most browsers allow you to set any search engine as default. You can easily switch to DuckDuckGo, Startpage, or other private alternatives in your browser settings. Privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser often come with private search engines set as default.

faqs.question: What's the difference between private search and incognito mode?
faqs.answer: Private search engines don't track your queries, while incognito mode only prevents your browser from saving history locally. Incognito mode doesn't stop Google or other search engines from tracking you. For true privacy, use both a private search engine and incognito mode together.

faqs.question: Are private search engines free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes, all major private search engines are completely free. They typically make money through non-tracking advertising or affiliate partnerships rather than selling user data. This makes privacy accessible to everyone without subscription fees.
